submission.justification: Mixture-G3 at 2.0 mm gap achieves the best time resolution of 0.926 ns across all tested configurations. Simulations showed that all three mixtures perform optimally at 2mm gap, with performance degrading at both smaller (1mm) and larger (3mm) gaps. Mixture-G3 outperforms G2 by 34% (1.243 ns) and G1 by 113% (1.969 ns) at the optimal 2mm gap. The configuration meets all technical constraints: gap is within 1-3mm range, mixture is from the candidate list, and is compatible with the 12kV HV system and 90% recirculation system. While G3 is a fluorinated mixture and G1/G2 represent newer environmental alternatives, no explicit environmental policy prohibition was found in the project documents, and the primary goal is to achieve the best possible time resolution.
